title: Choose the look for velarqo.com
question: Pick the visual world for the site. The first card is the one I'd build.

options.label: The Office Year Planner
options.lineage: the laminated wall year-planner in every installer's office, fitting jobs marked with coloured dot stickers
options.thesis: Your diary, filling up: old quotes turn into dots on next month's planner.
materials: marker handwriting on a ruled day grid
options.viewport: A full-width month grid of the planner with the headline over it; red 'booked' dots stuck into the day cells, the email button pinned like a sticker.
options.risk: Could look like a calendar app if the planner's print details (ruled grid, month bands, stickers) are drawn timidly.

raised.raise: Sticker colours run at full saturation as page-scale bands, not timid accents.
Each step leads with its promise in big type and flips to the plain detail underneath.
All numbers set in tabular figures, like a job sheet.

options.label: The Triplicate Quote Pad
options.lineage: the carbonless white/yellow/pink quote pad surveyors fill in at the kitchen table
options.thesis: The site is the pink copy of a quote that never came back, and what we do with it.
materials: printed ruled boxes and a firm's letterhead
options.viewport: A stack of three quote copies fanned at an angle, a big headline set in the letterhead box, the email button in the 'Customer signature' field.
options.risk: The most obvious reading of 'old quotes', so it's also where most designers would land.

options.label: Solidarity Silkscreen Poster
options.thesis: One bold emblem in flat hot colour fields.
options.viewport: One emblem centred, slogan wrapped round the edges.
options.risk: Political-poster energy confuses a sceptical trades owner.
options.case: Loses on both: installers don't recognise it and the offer gets lost.
options.kept: Total colour commitment, now used in the planner's bands.

options.label: Seed Packet Rack
options.thesis: Promise on the front, instructions on the back.
options.viewport: A rack of packets, each flipping to its instructions.
options.risk: Garden imagery has nothing to do with windows.
options.case: Loses on both: wrong world for installers, and the offer isn't clearer.
options.kept: Promise-first then detail, now used in the steps.

options.label: Darkroom Exposure Record
options.thesis: Ruled boxes of numbers under an enlarger glow.
options.viewport: Overlapping translucent sheets with numeric hatching.
options.risk: Far too abstract for this audience.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean, conventional B2B service landing page, done properly.
canonCard.viewport: Headline, subline and button on the left, three steps, FAQ, contact.
canonCard.risk: Looks like every other agency site, which is what we're trying to avoid.
